claim: Positional record properties no longer produce MsgPack005 when their Key attribute contains null. A positional record property is declared by ParameterSyntax rather than PropertyDeclarationSyntax, so GetPropertyIdentifierLocation returns null even though the property is in source. ReportIfLocatedInCompilation then silently drops the diagnostic. For example, `[MessagePackObject] public partial record R([property: Key(null)] string P);` should report MsgPack005 but does not.
